import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe")
py = str(repo / ".venv" / "bin" / "python")
compile_run = subprocess.run([py, "-m", "py_compile", str(repo / "jobpipe.py")], cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True)
if compile_run.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(compile_run.stderr)

help_run = subprocess.run([py, str(repo / "jobpipe.py"), "--help"], cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(help_run.stdout)
if help_run.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(help_run.stderr)
if "usage:" not in help_run.stdout.lower():
    raise SystemExit("jobpipe --help did not produce CLI usage")
print("jobpipe wrapper smoke test passed")
